Subject: Update on Department Budget Request

Dear [Recipient Name],

I am writing to provide an update regarding our recent request for a budget increase for the department. After careful review, we have decided not to approve the request at this time. The justification provided in the original submission does not currently align with the company’s broader financial strategy.

However, we are open to reconsidering this request if it can be resubmitted with additional context. Specifically, please include a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits to help us better understand the value and impact of this investment.

Please let me know if you have any questions or if you would like to discuss this further.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
